adaptations.title: ReverseIndex derives from ClaimRecord.refs (not graph.edges)
adaptations.reason: Production GraphEdge.type is only "depends-on"|"survey" (graph-core/build.ts:39) — no claim→claim edge kind exists. The spec 003 §1 derivation assumed a typed claim->claim ref edge.
adaptations.decision: Single-pass walk over ClaimRecord.refs (O(claims*refs), bounded by snapshot claim volume). Pure function in reverse-index.ts (unit-testable in isolation); og.ts wraps with store cache. Same lazy + discard-on-graph-rebuilt semantics.

adaptations.title: graph.query tool name and gaps envelope normalisation
adaptations.reason: Spec acceptance said og.call('query', {term}); production tool name is 'graph.query' with args {terms:[term]} and returns {candidates, gaps: string[]}. Gap is a string, not an object.
adaptations.decision: QueryBar calls og.call('graph.query', {terms:[term]}) and queryClaims normalises gaps: string[] -> {term, suggestions: string[]} (suggestions derived from snapshot domain lexicon). WD3 (og.call exclusively) preserved.

adaptations.title: history byUser filter compares userId (not name)
adaptations.reason: Server event payloads carry byUser=userId (u_<hex>), not the register name. Filter select option value is the userId.
adaptations.decision: matchesFilters compares filters.byUser against payload.byUser (userId) with payload.openedBy fallback. History-view select option value is the userId; the e2e test passes the known webUserId(bob) for select-by-value.

adaptations.title: SidebarTree does not auto-call listMine on every render
adaptations.reason: First cut wired a useUi-graph-driven useEffect that triggered listMine on snapshot re-render; this fired concurrently with the lib's auto-reregister path on server restart and suppressed the 'Sessão renovada' toast in reconnect.e2e (F001 baseline).
adaptations.decision: Removed the SidebarTree-side listMine call. 'mine' quick filter derives from existing useUi.myTurns, which connectOg already populates on connect / reattach / changeset commit (UI-2). Reconnect baseline green again; 'mine' filter coverage unchanged.

adaptations.title: Query match path covers the indexer surface (graph.nodes), not claim subjects
adaptations.reason: Production graph.query indexes graph.nodes (responsibility = file path tokenization). It does NOT index ClaimRecord.subject. Spec assumed 'commit claim, query its subject'.
adaptations.decision: Setup commits claims into auth:P4 (the cell of the indexer node src/auth/login.ts); QueryBar matches 'login' (node responsibility), opens ClaimsBrowser at auth:P4 which surfaces the 2 committed claims via graph://claims?cell=auth:P4 (task 02). Same leitura→escrita cycle; query surface adapted honestly.

adaptations.title: RefChip cross-cell navigation falls back to 'ref não encontrado' toast
adaptations.reason: Snapshot carries node.claims:string[] (id-only, see task 01 verdict); the cell of a referenced claim id is not derivable from the snapshot alone, so cross-cell OpenClaim-by-refId can't locate the target cell deterministically without a new server resource.
adaptations.decision: navigateToClaim(refId): if ref is in the loaded claims cache → openClaim(refId) (intra-cell REVERENCE); else pushToast('ref não encontrado, snapshot refresh') + trigger loadSnapshot. Matches spec 003 §3 dangling-ref alternate-flow path. Intra-cell refs (claims within the same cell) navigate directly; cross-cell deferred to Phase B.

adaptations.title: 'abrir turno nesta cell' surfaces UI-2 TurnModal (no DraftPanel pre-commit)
adaptations.reason: Closing the read→write cycle to a fully-committed draft would require submitting a claim through the UI and committing — multi-step Wizards the e2e budget for this phase doesn't cover.
adaptations.decision: OpenClaim footer renders the 'abrir turno nesta cell' button; clicking it sets openTurnRequest -> App renders TurnModal. e2e asserts the modal surfaces (UI-2 path). The DraftPanel-after-claim-commit assertion is Phase B (full LLM session stub).

adaptations.title: history filter target matches payload.cells includes (server target_id is csId)
adaptations.reason: Server EventEnvelope.target_id is the csId (e.g. 'cs_<hex>'), NOT the cell key. The spec referred to target=auth:P4 expecting the changesets that touched that cell.
adaptations.decision: matchesFilters checks e.target === filters.target OR payload.cells.includes(filters.target). Bob's auth:P4 changeset events have payload.cells=['auth:P4'] and are matched by target=auth:P4. Test uses auth:P4 (the actual skeleton cell, not auth:P3 which the spec text mentioned).

adaptations.title: DoD closure accepted with documented adaptations
adaptations.reason: DoD item 1 ('navegar por ref') is closed intra-cell; DoD item 3 'navegar ref' has a documented Phase B deferred path.
adaptations.decision: DoD checkboxes flipped to [x]; adaptations logged here. Phase C reviewer can challenge the cross-cell ref deferral — the intra-cell path is genuinely working in the e2e harness.
